item.title: Records show Dutch Coast Guard lacks means to guard North Sea cables despite threats
item.description: The Dutch Coast Guard lacks the staff, funding, and capacity to protect vital internet cables, power lines, and pipelines in the North Sea against espionage and sabotage, even as intelligence services warn the threat remains high and a cargo ship carrying explosive chemicals recently moved through Dutch waters, according to internal government documents cited by NRC.

item.title: Council of State: asylum seekers must count compensation toward housing costs
item.description: Asylum seekers who received compensation because the Immigration and Naturalisation Service (IND) took too long to decide on their asylum application must hand over any amount above a certain threshold to help pay for their accommodation. The Council of State (RvS) decided this on Wednesday, in line with the procedure used by the reception organization COA.

item.title: NS to resume full train schedule on Friday after winter disruptions
item.description: A spokesperson for the Dutch Railways (NS) has said that the full train schedule is expected to be back on Friday. The travel planner had previously suggested that most routes would return to normal on Thursday evening. NS attributes the current reduced service to a shortage of trains caused by last week’s winter weather.The spokesperson explained that it was previously unclear if trains would be punctual on Friday, but the current expectation is that they will run on schedule.

item.title: Police launch manhunt after gunman flees Eindhoven apartment shooting
item.description: A full-scale manhunt is underway in Eindhoven after a shooting inside an apartment on Stationsplein on Wednesday. Police officers wearing bulletproof vests were stationed around the area as authorities searched for the suspect, ED reported.

item.title: Dutch chipmaker Nexperia alleges Chinese parent company damaged value to retake control
item.description: Nexperia has accused its Chinese parent company, Wingtech, of using a “scorched earth” strategy to try to reclaim control of the Nijmegen chipmaker. A company lawyer told the Enterprise Chamber in Amsterdam that the CEO appears willing to damage the company’s value rather than compromise.

item.title: Dutch man arrested in Frankfurt for alleged rape of 13-year-old stepsister
item.description: A 26-year-old Dutch man was arrested at Frankfurt Airport in Germany on Wednesday for the alleged rape of his 13-year-old stepsister. The suspect had been wanted under a European and Interpol alert issued by British authorities in December 2023.German police apprehended him after he arrived on a flight from Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. item.title: Explosion causes power outage in Amsterdam city center, west neighborhoods
item.description: Large portions of Amsterdam’s city center, and neighborhoods in the west and southwest of the capital were without power on Wednesday afternoon, after a report of an explosion at one of the city’s key electricity substations. There were four minor injuries reported, and tens of thousands of homes and businesses were without power. People were advised to only call emergency services for "life-threatening" situations before power was ultimately restored after more than 90 minutes.

item.title: Suspect in Leiderdorp murder had been scheduled for court over death threats
item.description: The suspect in the murder of a 52-year-old woman from Leiderdorp was already under supervision from the authorities. Marvin B., 37, the victim’s former boyfriend, was scheduled to appear in court on February 5 over “serious and persistent death threats” directed at the victim, named Elvira.

item.title: Rotterdam court upholds €1.1 million fine against Fortnite developer Epic Games
item.description: The Rotterdam District Court has upheld a decision by the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to fine Epic Games International, the developer of Fortnite. The watchdog imposed a fine of 1.1 million euros in 2024, concluding that the company had engaged in unfair commercial practices, with children as the primary target.

item.title: Maastricht City Councillor arrested on terrorism charge; Tied to Atlanta KLM incident
item.description: Police in Maastricht arrested a 32-year-old City Council member for threatening to drive onto a crowded shopping street with the intent to run people over.
